title: Dates, Months and Duration
introduction: Develop Primary 3 skills in dates, months and duration.
definition: Calendar calculations use the actual number of days in each month. In the Gregorian calendar, February has 28 days normally and 29 in leap years. A leap year is divisible by 4, except century years must also be divisible by 400.

examples.question: How many days from 29 April to 3 May, including both dates?
Is 2028 a leap year?
steps: 2028 is divisible by 4 and is not a century year.

exercises.question: Days in February in 2027?
exercises.solution: 2027 ÷ 4 = 506 remainder 3; not a leap year, so February has 28 days.

exercises.question: Days in February in 2028?
exercises.solution: 2028 ÷ 4 = 507; not a century year, so February has 29 days.

exercises.question: Days from 30 June to 2 July inclusive?
exercises.solution: 1 day in June + 2 days in July = 3 days.

exercises.question: Is 2100 a leap year? yes/no
exercises.solution: 2100 ÷ 400 = 5 remainder 100; century years must be divisible by 400, so no.

summary: Calendar calculations use the actual number of days in each month. In the Gregorian calendar, February has 28 days normally and 29 in leap years. A leap year is divisible by 4, except century years must also be divisible by 400.
